description: This update focuses on strengthening the platform's core foundation, improving stability, and refining the overall user experience. It introduces a more reliable video player, official legal documentation, expanded localization support, a range of UI/UX enhancements, and a fully rebuilt Roadmap page designed to make YokaiVerse feel smoother, clearer, and more consistent.
